Title: Bow to Your King
Writer: Simon Mirren, David Wolstencroft, Sasha Hails
Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Plot: Philippe returns to Versailles a war hero. Louis holds a celebration, while losing confidence in Fabian due to the constant highway robberies that are impeding the funding of his palace. Cassel refuses to attend the celebration.
